author: David LaPorte
releaseNotes: New Use HTTPS setting (off by default): the login, commands and snapshot URL go over HTTPS, accepting the camera's self-signed certificate. New Reboot command; for 5 minutes after it, the camera being unreachable isn't logged as an error, and one line says when it's back. healthStatus changes are logged once. Includes 0.10.1's clearer title for the keep-on setting. Requires Hubitat 2.2.9+.
